function.name: check_availability_tool
function.description:
Use these tool to checks the availability on google calendar

Use Asia/Calcutta Timezone 

Note:
These tools must be return unavailable if date and time are already occupied 

for example :
If someone booked the appointment on 17 April at 10 am and another person give same date and time you must be say that slot is unavailable

messages.content: Please hold on. I am checking available slots
